_readme:
Shared contract for bmlib#504: a paper's retraction status. bmlib's Python (tests/test_retraction_status.py) and Rust (rust/bmlib/tests/retraction_status.rs) assert against this file, and so do bmlibrarian_lite's three platforms. Expected values are hand-written, never generated by the code under test.

rule_cases: crossref is null when Crossref was not asked; otherwise {status, body | body_text} is one batch's HTTP answer. Run parse_crossref_retraction_response(status, bytes, [doi]) and take its single result. bytes is body_text verbatim, or body serialised as JSON. Then retraction_status(doi, export, that result or null, publication_types) must equal expected. export null means the Retraction Watch export was not consulted; [] means it was consulted and held nothing.

parse_cases: parse_crossref_retraction_response(status, bytes, requested), keyed by normalised DOI (lower-cased, doi.org prefix stripped). An unreachable result's reason is not part of the contract and is omitted from expected.

request_cases: crossref_retraction_requests(dois, mailto) must equal expected exactly.

Evidence: {source, kind, date (ISO, as precise as deposited), notice_doi (lower-cased), record_id, raw_kind (the source's own spelling)}. 10.5555 is Crossref's test prefix: those cases are constructed, the others say where their data came from.

rule_cases.name: wakefield_1998
rule_cases.note: RW correction 2004, then RW retraction 2010. The export and Crossref's RW copy tie on 2010-02-06; the export's copy is shown. Export rows from a 2026-03 copy of the Crossref-distributed Retraction Watch CSV. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: surgisphere_nejm
rule_cases.note: Expression of concern 2020-06-02, then retraction 2020-06-04. Export rows from a 2026-03 copy of the Crossref-distributed Retraction Watch CSV. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: surgisphere_nejm_before_retraction
rule_cases.note: The NEJM paper as it stood on 2020-06-03: concern only. Constructed from the live records.

rule_cases.name: surgisphere_lancet_notice_guard
rule_cases.note: The retraction NOTICE 10.1016/s0140-6736(20)31324-6 is updated-by a publisher 'retraction' naming the paper it retracts, which its own update-to also names: the guard ignores it. The notice is not an original paper in the export. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: surgisphere_lancet_duplicate_across_three_sources
rule_cases.note: The retracted paper: export record 23529, Crossref's RW copy of it (same date, notice 31324-6), a publisher retraction under a second notice DOI (31174-0, guarded: the paper's own update-to names it), and the PubMed label. The export's copy is shown. Export rows from a 2026-03 copy of the Crossref-distributed Retraction Watch CSV. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: surgisphere_lancet_paper_crossref_alone
rule_cases.note: The paper lists its notices in its OWN update-to, so a guard on every source would discard its retractions. Retraction Watch's relations are never guarded, so Crossref alone still finds it retracted (maintainer's choice, 2026-10-18). Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: elsevier_self_reference_nbd
rule_cases.note: Updated-by a publisher retraction whose DOI is the paper's own; its update-to names itself. The guard exempts the paper's own DOI. Not in the export. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: elsevier_self_reference_jviromet
rule_cases.note: The same shape, titled 'RETRACTED: ...'; absent from the export. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: reinstated
rule_cases.note: Retracted 2019, reinstated 2021, both in the export and in Crossref's RW copy. Constructed (10.5555 is Crossref's test prefix).

rule_cases.name: label_only
rule_cases.note: Only the PubMed label says retracted; the export and Crossref answered with nothing. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: label_with_every_other_source_unreachable
rule_cases.note: The label settles retraction on its own. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: label_beaten_by_a_later_reinstatement
rule_cases.note: A dated reinstatement is later than the undated label. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: label_beats_an_undated_reinstatement
rule_cases.note: Only a reinstatement dated later undoes the label; an undated one is not later. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: same_day_retractions_show_retraction_watch
rule_cases.note: One retraction reported by the export and by the publisher under different notice DOIs on one date: the export's curated copy is shown. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: no_doi_pmid_found_in_export
rule_cases.note: Export record 69425: no DOI for the original paper, PMID 18401974. Crossref cannot be asked. Export rows from a 2026-03 copy of the Crossref-distributed Retraction Watch CSV.

rule_cases.name: no_doi_no_pmid
rule_cases.note: Nothing to look up anywhere.

rule_cases.name: doi_unknown_to_crossref_found_in_export
rule_cases.note: 10.4314/jfas.v10i4s.222 is not a Crossref DOI: absent from a successful batch. Export record 22696 decides alone. Export rows from a 2026-03 copy of the Crossref-distributed Retraction Watch CSV.

rule_cases.name: doi_unknown_to_crossref_nothing_found
rule_cases.note: Crossref does not know the DOI and the export holds nothing: unchecked, not clear (maintainer's choice, 2026-10-18). Constructed.

rule_cases.name: failed_crossref_batch_429
rule_cases.note: A throttled batch is unreachable, never 'not known'.

rule_cases.name: failed_crossref_batch_malformed
rule_cases.note: An HTML error page at HTTP 200.

rule_cases.name: export_not_consulted
rule_cases.note: No usable export copy. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: clear_control
rule_cases.note: Every source answered and none says anything. The control for the unchecked cases. Live Crossref answer, 2026-10-18 (filter=doi:..., select=DOI,update-to,updated-by), trimmed to this DOI's item.

rule_cases.name: unknown_crossref_type
rule_cases.note: A relation type outside the vocabulary is kept as 'other' and decides nothing (and is logged at WARNING once). Constructed.

rule_cases.name: equal_dates_reinstatement_wins
rule_cases.note: A retraction and a reinstatement on one date: the reinstatement can only follow it. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: undated_entry_is_oldest
rule_cases.note: An undated reinstatement is older than a dated retraction. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: partial_retraction_is_a_concern
rule_cases.note: Constructed.

rule_cases.name: concern_reported_while_crossref_unreachable
rule_cases.note: A concern stands while Crossref is down; unanswered says it may be worse. Export record 23525.

rule_cases.name: concern_undone_by_a_reinstatement
rule_cases.note: A reinstatement on or after the concern's date follows it. Constructed.

rule_cases.name: withdrawal_with_a_month_only_date
rule_cases.note: A withdrawal retracts; a date deposited to the month stays at that precision. Constructed.

parse_cases.name: served_served_not_known
parse_cases.note: Requested in any case; keyed by the normalised DOI. An item nobody asked for is ignored.

parse_cases.name: an_item_not_an_object
parse_cases.note: Absence means nothing once one item is unreadable, so the whole batch fails.

parse_cases.name: one_items_relations_unreadable
parse_cases.note: updated-by is an object: that DOI alone is unreachable.

parse_cases.name: unknown_relation_source
parse_cases.note: The source decides whether the notice guard may discard a relation, so it is not guessed.

parse_cases.name: dates
parse_cases.note: Partial dates keep their precision; an impossible or non-integer date is undated; a relation DOI may be absent.
